title: Counting Past Your Fingers
label: ch:cien-y-la-cantidad
canDo: I can say cien, la cantidad, ambos, varios and el triple, and say why cien and English hundred are the same word split by one sound change.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C351-triple: count to a hundred, name an amount, take two together, say there are several, and treble a figure.
